review.headline: Easy 10 km done at 5:44/km, steady and well inside the easy range.
observations: Distance 10.01 km matches the 10 km easy target; pace 5:44/km sits inside the 5:11-6:13/km band.
Every km split was 344 s with average HR 138-142, so pacing was very even and controlled.
Average HR 140 matches the 4-week easy HR average, and efficiency 1.247 is in line with recent easy runs.
flags: No RPE or note was logged, so perceived effort is unknown.
Training load is low: weekly actual km is far below plan (16 km in week 2, none since), and the CTL is falling to 33.1 from about 43.
